baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative bi-ayyi governs the plural ala'i, while rabbikuma and tukadhdhiban bind the grants to one nurturer and two addressed deniers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed favors are not free-floating goods: ownership and nurturing completion identify their source, and form-II denial attempts to classify either the grants or their giver as false. The question presses each member of the addressed pair to produce a defensible exception.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supplies the concrete grant-domain over which 'which' ranges.
Lordship, ownership, and authority assign the favors to an accountable giver-recipient relation.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the gifts stages of care rather than isolated objects.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false gives denial its active classificatory force.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about blessings being denied.
changed_reading.after: A dual-addressed demand to identify which concrete stage of a sovereign nurturer's care can coherently be declared false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ala'i, rabbikuma, and tukadhdhiban each carry a legal-performance branch within the focus inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The favor reading can carry an oath-and-covenant undertone: a pledged bond issues a charge, and the truth of that charge is shown by whether it is carried through. Denial therefore includes failed performance, not only false speech.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making overlays the favors with a pledged or binding edge.
A covenant or pact turns lordly relation into a bond with consequences.
A charge proving true or false by completion makes conduct the test of denial.

changed_reading.before: The pair is accused only of verbal disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The pair is asked which lordly bond they will make false by failing to carry its demanded response through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The favor, nurture, duration, and expectation-failure branches all attach to ala'i, rabbikuma, and tukadhdhiban in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gift proves itself through maintained nurture. The denial verb can resonate with provision that disappears after being expected to last, so the question tests whether the recipients judge the Lord's care unreliable.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the provision being evaluated.
Nurture and completion make continued maintenance part of the gift.
Staying and lasting supply the expected durability of lordly care.
Milk that fails to last despite expectation turns denial into a reliability judgment.

changed_reading.before: Denial disputes that a gift exists.
changed_reading.after: Denial also treats the Lord's provision as if it will fail expectation and cease before nurture is complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped inventory for ala'i supplies following and answering voices, while the dual verb makes two respondents grammatically present.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative can be heard as a call that structurally awaits a following voice. On this form-distant activation, denial is not only a proposition but a defective response to a disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies a response expected after the question.
A voice following another turns the dual question into a possible responsorial cue.
Declaring false names the negative answer that the call exposes.

changed_reading.before: One speaker delivers a closed rhetorical accusation.
changed_reading.after: The question opens a response slot: a voice from each addressee is due to follow, and denial is one possible failed answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening demand for just measure, prohibition of short measure, and later reciprocal recompense turn the covenantal baseline into a running account. Each refrain posts another recognized share; the remaining claim follows both recipients until their response makes the charge true or false.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability that follows its holder supplies the outstanding claim of recognition.
Covenant binds the account to the relation with the Lord.
A charge succeeds or fails in performance, making response the settlement test.
The balance of justice supplies the governing standard for the account.
Share and allotment make each disclosed favor a portion to be acknowledged.
Shortchanging a measure supplies the failure-mode of diminished recognition.
Answering an act with its recompense closes the account through reciprocity.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 establishes a balance and forbids diminution before the refrain cycle accumulates.
55:60 states good's recompense as good within the later garden sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies balance, allotted share, short measure, recompense, covenant, and a following liability; I infer that repeated disclosure accrues a claim of recognition. A live alternative is that measure and recompense frame conduct generally without making the refrain quasi-ledger-like.

changed_reading.before: Each occurrence asks for assent to an isolated favor.
changed_reading.after: At 55:49 the branching gardens enter a measured reciprocal account, and denial shortchanges an outstanding claim that follows both recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact refrains before and after 55:49 realize the focus-only voice-following branch as audible sequence. The verse becomes an answering turn between disclosures, with the dual addressees repeatedly summoned into the response chain.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice supplies the focus verse's responsorial possibility.
Declaring false identifies the resistant answer exposed by the recurring call.
The preceding identical refrain supplies the first voice in the local exchange.
The following identical refrain answers and continues the local exchange.

structural_cues: 55:47, 55:49, and 55:51 repeat the same dual question at two-ayah intervals.
Each local refrain follows one disclosure and precedes another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact interval repetition and the non-dominant branch of one voice following another; I infer that recitation enacts a call-and-response demand. The materially live alternative is a single speaker's rhetorical refrain with no implied second voice.

changed_reading.before: A semantically repeated accusation interrupts the description.
changed_reading.after: At 55:49 the refrain is an answering turn in a chain, so silence or denial becomes a failed response to the branch-filled disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast of cessation and remaining, followed by continuously running provision and closed by stable growing good, sharpens the reliable-provision baseline. The garden is a maintained process whose duration answers the root-image of supply failing expectation.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor names the provision whose durability is tested.
Staying and lasting place persistence inside the Lord relation.
Provision that vanishes after seeming durable supplies the precise expectation-failure being denied.
Cessation after prior existence establishes the failure pole.
Continuance and remaining establish the counter-pole anchored in the Lord.
Continuing provision and giving make the springs a maintenance mechanism.
Stable, growing good names the durable productivity reached at the surah's close.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 directly juxtaposes everything on earth passing with the Lord-facing remainder.
55:49 stands between a branching canopy at 55:48 and continuously running springs at 55:50.
55:78 closes the whole sequence with blessed increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, persistence, continuous giving, and stable growth; I infer that water-mediated renewal is evidence of sustained nurture. The alternative is that these are adjacent gifts without a durability argument.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether the garden counts as a gift at all.
changed_reading.after: The question asks whether the pair will misclassify a renewing, maintained ecology as provision that fails to last.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expected harm and exposed standing before the Lord are answered by two tree-screened, protective gardens whose branches extend around the recipient. Favor at 55:49 becomes a reversal from vulnerable accountability into inhabited shelter.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor names the beneficial reversal produced by the sequence.
Nurture and completion supply the agentive care that converts exposure into shelter.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the vulnerable initial state.
Standing or station supplies exposure before the Lord.
A garden screened by trees supplies the inhabitable shelter.
A protecting shield makes concealment function as safety rather than mere scenery.
Extending, ramified branches provide the material architecture of the shelter.

structural_cues: The conditional recipient at 55:46 receives two gardens, described at 55:48, before the focus refrain.
Dual gardens mirror the dual possessive and verb in 55:49 without collapsing the two addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, standing, two screened gardens, protection, and branches; I infer a directional reversal from exposed accountability to divinely nurtured shelter. A live alternative is simple reward-after-fear rather than material transformation of the feared condition.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are rewards listed after judgment.
changed_reading.after: At 55:49 favor names a reversal mechanism: vulnerable standing before the Lord is answered by doubled, branch-woven protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding afnan can mean both ramified branches and multiple kinds or ways; fruit then arrives in paired kinds. These cues make bi-ayyi distributive over a branching taxonomy of care rather than over a flat list of benefits.

activation_trace.role: Plural bestowed favors provide the classes differentiated by the interrogative.
Nurture and completion unify the different branches as modes of one care.
Kinds, modes, and ways turn botanical plurality into a taxonomy.
A ramifying branch gives that taxonomy a material growth-form.
A kind or category of a thing confirms that the garden's abundance is classified, not amorphous.

structural_cues: 55:48 immediately precedes the focus with dual gardens possessing afnan.
55:50 and 55:52 continue dual sources and paired fruit after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branch/kind polysemy and paired categories; I infer that the focus interrogative asks the pair to differentiate among ramifying modes of nurture. The alternative is that afnan remains only literal canopy and does not organize ala'i conceptually.

changed_reading.before: Which one item in a flat inventory of favors will you deny?
changed_reading.after: Which ramifying kind or pathway of your Lord's care, embodied in this paired ecology, can either addressee mark false?

context_deltas.mechanism: The two springs immediately after the focus carry both water-source and seeing branches. Their flow turns the garden into self-presenting evidence: the sources that sustain it also function as figurative eyes against an act of declaring false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor identifies what the visible scene evidences.
Declaring a thing false supplies the evidentiary contradiction.
A source of running water supplies the literal sustaining springs.
Direct sight lets the same root activate the springs as figurative witnesses.
Flowing and coursing make the evidence active and observable.

structural_cues: 55:49 is followed immediately by 'in both are two springs running.'
The two springs echo the two addressees without requiring a one-to-one identification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the eye/spring branch pair and actual flow; I infer that material sources can figuratively witness against denial. The alternative is that the seeing branches remain inactive and 'ayn names water sources only.

changed_reading.before: The pair is asked to accept a reported favor.
changed_reading.after: The scene produces its own visible witnesses: two running sources make declaring the garden false an act against presented evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branches, flowing water, harvest taken from its growth-place, and nearness form a production-and-delivery chain. The Lord's favor is a functioning ecology that moves growth toward accessible yield, while the denial root's no-delay branch makes recognition answer that delivery promptly.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion provide the system's governing process.
Not delaying to act turns completed delivery into pressure for prompt recognition.
Ramified growth supplies the productive canopy.
Coursing flow supplies the inferred transport and renewal link.
Taking produce from its growth-place supplies realized yield.
Nearness makes the yield accessible to the recipients.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from branches at 55:48 through springs at 55:50 and fruit pairs at 55:52 to near harvest at 55:54.
The focus refrain occupies the threshold between productive structure and its sustaining flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branches, flow, harvest, and nearness; I supply the causal arrows that water sustains growth and growth yields accessible fruit. The live alternative is a sequence of independent pleasures rather than one working system.

changed_reading.before: The refrain interrupts a static catalogue of garden luxuries.
changed_reading.after: The refrain challenges denial of a functioning delivery system in which nurture moves from branching growth through flow to harvest within reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the plant-name branch of ala'i and the deceptive-cloth branch of k-d-b rather than their dominant senses. It remains anchored in both exact focus roots and is locally awakened by afnan's unstable variegation; downstream prose should present it only as a sensory-epistemic undertone, not as a replacement gloss for favors or denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ala'i can name a beautiful-looking bitter shrub, while tukadhdhiban carries an image of variegated cloth whose appearance deceives.

activation_trace.role: A shrub beautiful in appearance but bitter in taste introduces divided sensory evidence.
A variegated cloth that deceives by its condition makes surface display epistemically suspect.
Unstable mixing and variegation connects the branching garden surface to the deception test.

changed_reading.before: Lush visible beauty straightforwardly proves favor.
changed_reading.after: The refrain briefly tests surfaces: branching color can look beneficent yet be bitter or deceptive unless it bears the truth of sustaining care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the wild-animal stopping image is idiomatically distant from form-II denial. It remains anchored in k-d-b and gains rhythmic support from sequential refrains around a flowing verb; downstream prose should qualify it as a pacing effect or secondary activation, never as the lexical meaning of tukadhdhiban.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial root includes an image of running a stage, stopping, and looking behind; the refrain itself occupies just such an arresting position.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping to look back supplies the refrain's possible rhythmic brake.
A remainder following what came before makes the stopped verse gather the prior disclosure.
The preceding refrain establishes the repeated sequence of pauses.
Forward flow resumes immediately after the focus pause.
The next refrain confirms that resumed description reaches another checkpoint.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely repeats semantic content.
changed_reading.after: The refrain acts as a checkpoint that halts the image-run, makes both addressees look back at the disclosed branches, and only then releases the flow toward the springs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates foster-family and growth branches under rabb and extends them across the human-jinn dual. It remains anchored in rabbikuma's dual possessive and is supported by kinship, sociability, hidden jinn, and pairing cues; downstream prose should call it a relational overlay, not claim that rabb literally means step-parent here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rabbikuma grammatically joins two addressees to one Lord, while the focus inventory includes fostered-family and growing-up branches.

activation_trace.role: A fostered child and step-family relation casts lordship as household-forming care.
Nurture and growing up give that shared household a developmental direction.
Kinship supplies a relational frame at the surah's opening.
Sociability that removes estrangement characterizes the human side of the pair.
Hidden jinn supplies the unlike second recipient joined by the dual.
Making one thing a companion to another mirrors the pairing of unlike dependents.

changed_reading.before: Human and jinn are two separately accused audiences.
changed_reading.after: The dual address can momentarily form them into one paired household of unlike dependents being reared by the same Lord, so denial ruptures a care relation as well as a claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports k-d-b's formula of urging into a form-II interrogative. It remains rooted in tukadhdhiban and coheres with oath, authority, near harvest, and taking yield; downstream prose should render it as an exhortative resonance beneath the accusation, not as a direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denial root includes a formula meaning that something is incumbent or should be taken up, while ala'i and rabbikuma can add oath and authority.

activation_trace.role: The formula of urging or obligation reverses accusation into pressure to take the favors up.
Oath-making gives the exhortation a binding undertone.
Lordly authority supplies the source of the incumbent claim.
Taking yield from its growth-place materializes the act of receiving.
Nearness makes the demanded reception immediately practicable.

changed_reading.after: Beneath the accusation sounds a contained imperative: which favors will you take up as incumbent now that their harvest has been brought within reach?

strongest_changes: The branch-flow-harvest sequence turns abstract favors into a self-renewing and accessible garden system.
Exact refrain recurrence plus the non-dominant T-L-W inventory turns 55:49 into an antiphonal response point.
Measure, no-shortfall, covenant, and recompense recast denial as deficient recognition in a running account.
Perishing, remaining, continuous provision, and stable growth make durability a central test of the garden gift.
Fear and exposed standing are materially reversed into doubled branch-woven shelter.
summary.what_was_special: All three focus roots opened more than one live mechanism, and the verse's placement between ramified canopy and running springs activated both local ecological causality and the surah-wide refrain rhythm. The result is not one disambiguated reading but coexisting gift, covenant, durability, response, evidence, shelter, and exhortation models.
remaining_uncertainties: The T-L-W mapping, plant-name ala, deceptive-cloth, foster-family, and urging branches are form-distant and should remain explicitly secondary activations.
The causal arrows from water to growth and from fear to shelter are reader-supplied even though their endpoints and sequence are packet-supplied.
The eye/spring witness model depends on activating two branches of 'ayn simultaneously rather than taking 'ayn only as a water source.
The dual household reading may reflect rhetorical pairing of human and jinn rather than a social ontology of shared fosterage.
